crops.name: Corn (maize)
crops.notes: High-yield, high-residue grass crop; heavy nitrogen user.

crops.name: Soybean
crops.notes: Fixes its own nitrogen; low residue leaves soil exposed after harvest.

crops.name: Winter wheat
crops.notes: Covers the soil over winter; early-summer harvest opens a window for a cover crop.

crops.name: Spring wheat
crops.notes: Cool-season cereal for short or cold-winter seasons.

crops.name: Spring barley
crops.notes: Short-season cereal; malting or feed markets.

crops.name: Oats
crops.notes: Good nurse crop for underseeding clover or alfalfa; breaks disease cycles of wheat.

crops.name: Grain sorghum
crops.notes: Very drought and heat tolerant, deep roots; a water-saving alternative to corn.

crops.name: Cotton
crops.notes: Long hot season needed; low residue leaves soil exposed.

crops.name: Sunflower
crops.notes: Deep taproot scavenges deep nutrients and water; drought tolerant.

crops.name: Winter canola / oilseed rape
crops.notes: Broadleaf break crop in cereal rotations; taproot improves soil structure.

crops.name: Field pea
crops.notes: Cool-season pulse; fixes nitrogen and frees a late-summer window.

crops.name: Dry beans
crops.notes: Short-season pulse with good markets in some regions; sensitive to waterlogging.

crops.name: Chickpea
crops.notes: Drought-tolerant pulse for dry climates; needs well-drained soil.

crops.name: Lentil
crops.notes: Low-water pulse suited to semi-arid areas.

crops.name: Potato
crops.notes: High value but soil-disturbing; needs reliable water.

crops.name: Sugar beet
crops.equipment: precision drill, beet harvester; processor contract
crops.notes: Deep-rooted break crop; usually needs a processor contract.

crops.name: Proso millet
crops.notes: Very short, very low-water summer grain for dryland systems.

crops.name: Alfalfa (lucerne)
crops.notes: Perennial legume hay (2+ years); deep roots, builds soil N and structure, high water use.

crops.name: Cereal rye (cover)
crops.equipment: drill or broadcast; roller-crimper or herbicide to terminate
crops.notes: Hardiest winter cover; scavenges leftover nitrate, strong erosion control. Can tie up N before corn.

crops.name: Crimson clover (cover)
crops.notes: Winter-annual legume for milder winters; supplies N to the next crop.

crops.name: Hairy vetch (cover)
crops.notes: Cold-hardy legume cover; high N supply to a following corn crop.

crops.name: Red clover (cover)
crops.equipment: frost-seed or drill after small grain
crops.notes: Classic cover after a small grain; fixes N and protects soil through winter.

crops.name: Tillage radish (cover)
crops.notes: Deep taproot breaks compaction ('bio-drilling'); winter-kills, leaving little residue.

crops.name: Buckwheat (summer cover)
crops.notes: Fast summer cover after an early harvest; smothers weeds, feeds pollinators.

crops.name: Cowpea (summer cover)
crops.notes: Heat- and drought-tolerant legume cover for hot summers.

crops.name: Sorghum-sudangrass (summer cover/forage)
crops.notes: Huge biomass summer cover or emergency forage; very drought tolerant.

crops.name: Fallow (no crop)
crops.notes: Bare fallow year used to store soil water in dryland systems; high erosion risk.
